name: Your Package Has Arrived

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the ties between the Bronzebeards of Ironforge and their Wildhammer cousins in Aerie Peak. Getting this parcel safely to its recipient honors those ties.
As an Alliance member, you know reliable communication between the Hinterlands and Ironforge matters to Alliance interests across Khaz Modan and the northern territories.

aliases: what was left by the mailbox
faq.answer: It is an urgent parcel from Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands, addressed to Eldrun Stormbreaker in Ironforge. It was left beside a mailbox with several other packages instead of reaching its destination.
faq.q: What is the package found by the mailbox?

faq.answer: Eldrun Stormbreaker is the named recipient of the misplaced parcel in Ironforge. The label gives Eldrun’s name and marks the package urgent, but says little else until it reaches its recipient.

aliases: where did the package come from
faq.answer: The parcel came from Aerie Peak, the Wildhammer clan’s settlement and fortress in the mountains of the Hinterlands. It was bound for Ironforge before it was misplaced near a mailbox along the way.
faq.q: Where was the parcel sent from?

faq.answer: The sender marked the crate urgent because its contents or arrival time mattered. A delay on the long journey from Aerie Peak to Ironforge could cause trouble for Eldrun Stormbreaker.
faq.q: Why was the parcel marked urgent?

faq.answer: Several parcels were left abandoned beside a mailbox instead of being sorted and delivered. The reason is unknown, and the packages remain misplaced.
faq.q: Why was the package left sitting by a mailbox?

aliases: who do i bring the package to
faq.answer: The parcel is bound for Ironforge and addressed to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It needs to be carried to Eldrun inside the dwarven fortress city.
faq.q: Where does this package need to be delivered?

aliases: why send mail from aerie peak
faq.answer: Aerie Peak is home to the Wildhammer dwarves, and Ironforge is the seat of the Bronzebeard clan. The clans have distinct customs and homes, yet correspondence, trade, and kinship ties link the Hinterlands to the Great Forge beneath the mountain.
faq.q: What connection exists between Aerie Peak and Ironforge?

sections.body: Several parcels lie abandoned beside a city mailbox. They were left there instead of being carried to their destinations. One urgent parcel came from Aerie Peak, the Wildhammer dwarves’ mountain redoubt in the Hinterlands. Deliveries between distant outposts across Khaz Modan and Lordaeron can go awry. An alert passerby can carry a mislaid package onward.
sections.title: Misplaced Freight

sections.body: The parcel is addressed to Eldrun Stormbreaker in Ironforge. Its urgent notice marks the shipment as important enough to travel from the Hinterlands to the dwarven capital without delay. The crate still needs to reach Eldrun before it is stolen or forgotten.
sections.title: A Parcel for Eldrun Stormbreaker

summary: A parcel from Aerie Peak lies beside a city mailbox, bound for Ironforge. Marked urgent for Eldrun Stormbreaker, it still waits to be delivered.
attribution: In-game quest text: Your Package Has Arrived
